text:
maria: FYI — started onboarding open-embedding-2-small on staging for semantic QA. Running recall@1/5/10, cluster purity, and cosine-distrib checks against FAQ+KB corpora. Baseline: r-infer-embed-v1 and ada-sim. Will push results in ~2h.
ajay: Which dataset split/seed? want to run same eval locally.
maria: Using /datasets/faq_kb/2025-01-split (train/dev/test). Seed 42. Eval script: `python eval/embeddings_eval.py --model open-embedding-2-small --dataset faq_kb --split test --seed 42 --metrics recall@1,5,10,cluster_purity`
sophia: Can you include recall@100 and mean-rank? clustering uses HDBSCAN with min_cluster_size=5.
maria: Yep. Also enabling float16 + int8-post-train-quant. Will compare quant vs fp16.
deploy-bot: ci/deploy: finished building image open-embedding-2-small:2025-04-21-rc1
ajay: quick numbers? even rough.
sophia: Initial run on 10k samples: recall@5=0.71 (baseline 0.76), mAP@10=0.64 vs 0.69, cluster_purity -0.03 vs baseline. Cosine mean shift ~-0.02. int8 quant adds ~0.02 drop.
kevin: Ok let's run whitening + L2-normalize (post-process) and re-evaluate. Also check recall by query length bins.
maria: On it. Scheduling canary on prod-sim with 5% traffic after whitening if numbers recover.
ajay: Also add nearest-neighbor precision/recall per intent label. Some intents are brittle.
sophia: :thumbsup: I'll prep a quick notebook for t-SNE cluster viz and a script to compute per-intent recall@k.
maria: Thanks — I'll post final table + PR with eval artifacts here (csvs, figs, and evaluation logs).
